jobs.title: Director of Engineering, AI Platform
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our AI Platform organization. This group builds the foundational systems powering every AI experience across Asana. In this role, you will lead four key teams through their engineering managers: Context (search, retrieval, and knowledge extraction across the Asana Work Graph), LLM Foundations (model serving, inference infrastructure, provider strategy, and evaluation systems), and AI Efficiency (our center of excellence for cost, quality, and performance standards across all AI workloads). Collaborating with engineering managers and senior technical leaders, you will drive the end-to-end strategy, execution, and architecture that define how humans and AI work together at Asana to build trusted, reliable, high-value product workflows for enterprise customers worldwide. Your mission is to make Asana’s AI platform the most reliable, economical, and performant foundation in the industry for agentic enterprise software, giving Asana the leverage to ship AI products faster than anyone else.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What You’ll Achieve

Drive Strategy & Execution Across the AI Teammates Pillar: Lead the multi-year vision and technical strategy for Asana’s AI platform, covering retrieval and agent context, model serving and inference, model portfolio strategy, and evaluation systems.
Optimize AI Infrastructure Costs: Own cost-per-execution as a primary engineering metric, managing model selection, routing, open-weight versus frontier trade-offs, inference optimization, caching, and prompt efficiency to protect product margins at scale.
Establish AI Evaluation Frameworks: Establish evaluation frameworks, regression prevention, and performance standards that product teams can rely on out of the box, making quality, cost, and latency measurable defaults.
Lead and Mentor Teams: Lead and mentor managers and their teams across San Francisco and New York City, building autonomous owners, recruiting top talent, and maintaining high execution standards.
Manage Model Strategy: Evaluate when to adopt frontier models versus open-weight models and structure provider relationships to prevent vendor lock-in.
Architectural Leadership: Pressure-test architectural decisions, arbitrate build-versus-buy debates with data, and act as the trusted technical authority for AI infrastructure accuracy across the company.
Drive Cross-Functional Partnerships: Partner cross-functionally with product, go-to-market, and finance leaders to tie platform investments directly to business performance, unit margins, and enterprise trust.

About You

12+ years of software engineering experience with 5+ years of engineering leadership, including 2+ years managing engineering managers. You've built organizations, not just teams: you've hired and developed managers, restructured when the mission changed, and held a bar for both.
Proven track record of using AI tools daily, with deep expertise in serving architectures, inference providers, agentic frameworks, RAG architectures, and scale evaluation systems.
Proven experience optimizing infrastructure costs and unit economics at scale with concrete metrics and clear trade-offs.
Platform mindset centered on earning trust, establishing clear standards, providing responsive support, and using data to guide team priorities.
Skilled asynchronous communicator with experience leading distributed teams across time zones using strategy docs and decision memos.
Adaptable decision-maker who takes clear, evidence-based positions but pivots quickly as new data emerges.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What We’ll Offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $306,000-$360,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
Career coaching & support
Inclusive family building benefits
Long-term savings or retirement plans
In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences

These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

About Us

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.

We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive. Our goal is to ensure that Asana upholds an environment where all people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering & SaaS Platforms
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Director of Software Engineering provides strategic and operational leadership for software engineering teams responsible for designing, building, and scaling high quality software platforms and products. The role bridges business strategy and technical execution, ensuring engineering outcomes deliver customer value, operational excellence, and long term platform scalability.

This leader sets technical direction, develops engineering talent, and partners closely with Product, Platform Engineering, Security, Data, and Business leaders to drive innovation and reliable delivery across portfolios.

Responsibilities

Engineering & Technical Leadership
Define and drive the software engineering strategy and technical roadmap aligned with the Product Roadmap, business priorities and product vision.
Ensure adoption of engineering best practices across architecture, development, testing, CI/CD, security, and reliability.
Guide platform scalability, performance, and resilience across cloud and SaaS environments.
Evaluate and introduce new technologies where they create measurable business value (e.g., AI/ML, data platforms, automation).
Delivery & Execution
Own end‑to‑end delivery accountability for software initiatives, ensuring predictable execution, quality, and speed to market.
Partner with Product Management to translate business and customer needs into executable engineering plans.
Use AI to assist with product development and deployment of AI capabilities in our customer-facing solutions.
Establish and monitor KPIs and engineering metrics related to delivery, quality, reliability, and team health.
Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory standards across software products.
People & Organizational Leadership
Build, lead, and develop high‑performing engineering managers and teams.
Set clear accountabilities, performance objectives, and growth paths for leaders and individual contributors.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, ownership, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Support workforce planning, succession, and capability development aligned to future needs.
Cross‑Functional & Stakeholder Partnership
Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, Data, Operations, and Business leaders (GMs) to align priorities and execution.
Communicate complex technical topics clearly to executive and non‑technical stakeholders.
Represent Software Engineering in strategic planning, investment decisions, and governance forums

Success Measures

Delivery predictability and product quality
Platform scalability and reliability
Engineering talent retention and growth
Alignment between engineering output and business outcomes

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
Extensive experience in software engineering, with multiple years in senior engineering leadership roles.
Proven success leading large‑scale software platforms or SaaS products.
Strong understanding of modern software architectures, cloud platforms, DevOps practices, and secure development.
Demonstrated ability to lead through change and scale organizations.

Preferred Experience

Experience leading AI‑enabled, data‑driven, or platform‑centric software products.
Global or matrixed organizational leadership.
Budget ownership and investment prioritization.
Background in regulated or enterprise environments.

Success Measures

Delivery predictability and product quality
Platform scalability and reliability
Engineering talent retention and growth
Alignment between engineering output and business outcomes

Total Rewards: We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. The estimated salary range for this position is $177,000 to $236,000 and is based on multiple factors, including job-related knowledge/skills, experience, geographical location, as well as other factors. This position is eligible for annual bonus compensation with a target payout of 30% of the base salary and a 30% RSU grant. This position also provides health benefits such as medical, dental and vision; wellness benefits such as mental and financial health; and retirement savings (401K) commensurate with the standard rewards offered in each individual location or country. We also provide full-time employees with paid time off including vacation (20 days), holidays including 3 floating holidays (12 days) and sick time off (72 hours).

About Us

A global leader in applied safety science, UL Solutions (NYSE: ULS) transforms safety, security and sustainability challenges into opportunities for customers in more than 110 countries. UL Solutions delivers testing, inspection and certification services, together with software products and advisory offerings, that support our customers’ product innovation and business growth. The UL Mark serves as a recognized symbol of trust in our customers’ products and reflects an unwavering commitment to advancing our safety mission. We help our customers innovate, launch new products and services, navigate global markets and complex supply chains, and grow sustainably and responsibly into the future. Our science is your advantage.

jobs.description:
Want to help pets live their best lives?
We’re proud to be where the pets go and where the pet people go. If you want to make a real difference, create an exciting career path, feel welcome to be your whole self and nurture your wellbeing, Petco is the place for you
.
Our core values capture that spirit as we work to improve lives by doing what’s right for pets and people.
Pet First – Protect & Empower. All pets should Live their Best Life. We put the needs of pets and pet parents at the center of everything we do.
Foster the Fun – Connect & Bond. Our Passion for pets brings us together! We celebrate the journey of pet parenthood through district experiences, products, and services.
Let’s Go! Own & Commit. We are stronger as One Petco team. We bring our unique superpowers and champion authenticity in everyone to drive success.

About Petco

We’re proud to be "where the pets go"
to find everything they need to live their best lives for more than 60 years — from their favorite meals and toys, to trusted supplies and expert support from people who get it, because we live it. We believe in the universal truths of pet parenthood — the boundless boops, missing slippers, late night zoomies and everything in between. And we’re here for it. Every tail wag, every vet visit, every step of the way. We are 29,000+
strong and together we nurture the pet-human bond in more than 1,500
Petco stores across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, 250+
Vetco Total Care hospitals, hundreds of preventive care clinics and eight distribution centers. In 1999, we founded Petco Love. Together, we support thousands of local animal welfare groups nationwide and have helped find homes for approximately 7 million animals
through in-store adoption events.
Director, Point-of-Sale (POS) Engineering

As Director of POS Engineering, you'll lead the technology powering millions of customer transactions while helping redefine the modern retail experience. This is an opportunity to transform our Point-of-Sale ecosystem into a connected, cloud-enabled commerce platform that seamlessly brings together stores, digital channels, loyalty, payments, and customer experiences.
If you're passionate about modern engineering, large-scale distributed systems, and building high-performing teams that solve complex business challenges, we'd love to meet you.
What You'll Do

As the technology leader for Petco's Point of Sale platform, you'll define the engineering vision and execution strategy for one of the company's most business-critical systems.
Duties & Responsibilities

Define and execute the long-term engineering strategy and technical roadmap for Petco's Point of Sale ecosystem.
Drive modernization initiatives across POS applications, commerce services, and supporting retail systems.
Lead the architecture and delivery of scalable, resilient, cloud-enabled solutions that support thousands of stores and millions of customer interactions.
Partner with Product leaders to translate business strategy into innovative technical solutions that improve customer and associate experiences.
Champion engineering excellence through modern software development practices, automation, observability, and continuous delivery.
Oversee ongoing platform enhancements while balancing innovation, stability, security, and operational excellence.
Provide technical leadership for complex enterprise initiatives involving multiple systems and business stakeholders.
Identify technology opportunities that improve speed, reliability, scalability, and the overall retail experience.
Lead and develop distributed engineering teams while fostering a collaborative, high-performing engineering culture.
Communicate technology strategy, priorities, and execution updates to Directors, Vice Presidents, and other senior business leaders.

What You Bring

We're looking for a technology leader who combines deep engineering expertise with strong business partnership and people leadership.
Key Distinction Of Job Level

Leads large cross functional teams that work on the most complex business issues
Minimal supervision with wide latitude for independent judgment. Provides solutions to issues utilizing judgment.

Required Experience

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or other related fields, or equivalent work experience.
12+ years of IT and business industry work experience in managing multiple, large, cross-functional teams or projects, and influencing senior level management and key stakeholders.
Requires advanced technical and business knowledge in software development life cycle, quality assurance, project management and other related disciplines/processes.
Proven experience leading engineering teams responsible for enterprise Point of Sale (POS) platforms.
Experience delivering large-scale, highly available retail or commerce technology initiatives.
Strong understanding of omnichannel retail architecture and customer commerce experiences.
Experience with payment processing, payment gateways, loyalty platforms, and PCI compliance principles.
Experience partnering with Product Management to define roadmaps and prioritize engineering investments.
Demonstrated success leading geographically distributed engineering teams across onshore, offshore, and nearshore delivery models.
Strong executive presence with experience influencing Directors, Vice Presidents, and senior business leaders.

Technical Expertise

Experience leading engineering organizations building modern applications using technologies such as:
Java
Spring Boot
Microservices Architecture
GraphQL
Apache Kafka
AWS Cloud Services
Linux and/or Windows environments

Experience with cloud-native architecture, APIs, distributed systems, event-driven design, CI/CD, and modern engineering practices is highly valued.
Why Petco?

Technology at Petco directly impacts how millions of pet parents care for the pets they love. From checkout experiences and loyalty rewards to connected commerce and veterinary services, our engineering teams build platforms that make every interaction simpler, faster, and more meaningful.
If you're excited by modernizing enterprise retail technology, leading exceptional engineering teams, and helping shape the future of omnichannel commerce, we'd love to have you on our team.

Day to day, you will spend as much time in architecture reviews and roadmap planning as you will coaching the engineering managers who report to you. You will set technical standards, unblock delivery across multiple teams, and make the case for how cloud investment should evolve as the company scales. The person who thrives here has already led leaders, not just individual contributors, and is comfortable balancing hands-on technical judgment with the softer work of building a healthy, high-performing engineering organization.

COMPENSATION

The salary range for this role is $190,000 - $250,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.

Additional compensation and benefits details will be shared during the hiring process.

Responsibilities

Lead and develop a team of engineering managers responsible for cloud infrastructure and platform engineering
Set the architectural direction and technical roadmap for the organization's cloud platforms
Partner with product and business leadership to align infrastructure strategy with company growth plans
Drive delivery predictability across multiple engineering teams and workstreams
Establish standards for reliability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency across cloud environments
Oversee capacity planning, budgeting, and vendor relationships for cloud infrastructure
Build scalable processes for incident response, on call, and operational excellence
Recruit, mentor, and grow engineering managers and senior technical staff as the organization scales
Represent cloud engineering in executive planning and cross functional strategy discussions
Evaluate emerging cloud technologies and make build versus buy recommendations

Requirements

10 plus years of experience in cloud or infrastructure engineering, including direct people leadership
Proven experience managing engineering managers or leading multiple engineering teams
Deep hands on background with major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Strong track record of setting architecture direction for large scale distributed systems
Experience owning delivery timelines and coordinating across multiple engineering teams
Demonstrated success building and scaling engineering organizations through growth
Solid understanding of infrastructure security, compliance, and cost management practices

Director of Robotic Engineering

Location: Detroit, MI- Onsite
Type: Full-time
Security Clearance: No clearance required, must be clearable.

About Us

Eccalon provides global solutions to the most challenging technological issues of the 21st-century, and our evolving portfolio spans five major markets: Machine Learning, Cybersecurity, Aerospace & Defense, Material Sciences, Advance Manufacturing, Sports Science, Biotechnology, and Health & Life Sciences. Visit our website here.

Why Join Us?

Eccalon's Executives foster a supportive work environment allowing our teams to thrive, and have a fierce dedication to innovation, security, and people. Our culture is built on inclusion, teamwork, trust, and we are committed to offering career advancement opportunities to all employees. Encouraging a healthy and balanced life, we offer an extensive benefits package to support the wellness of our employees and their families. You will be joining a team of innovators, working with cutting edge technologies, supporting mission critical projects, and making an impact.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly experienced Director of Robotics Engineering to lead the vision, architecture, and execution of advanced robotic systems. This role requires deep technical expertise in robotics combined with strong leadership, product focus, and system‑level thinking. The Director will oversee end‑to‑end development of robotic platforms—from concept and architecture through prototyping, validation, and production—while mentoring technical leaders and driving innovation across hardware, software, and controls.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Own the technical vision and system architecture for robotic platforms and subsystems
Lead design and integration of robotics hardware, software, firmware, and controls
Guide decisions across kinematics, dynamics, sensing, perception, motion planning, and autonomy
Ensure system‑level performance, reliability, safety, and scalability

Team & Organizational Leadership

Build, lead, and mentor senior robotics engineers and technical managers
Establish engineering standards, best practices, and development processes
Foster a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and innovation
Partner with recruiting to hire top‑tier robotics talent

Product & Execution Ownership

Drive roadmap execution aligned with product, manufacturing, and business goals
Oversee prototyping, testing, validation, and production readiness
Manage technical risk, trade‑offs, and cross‑disciplinary dependencies
Support critical design reviews and milestone decision points

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

Collaborate with Product, Manufacturing, Quality, and Operations teams
Align robotics development with regulatory, safety, and compliance requirements
Support customer engagements, demos, and executive‑level technical discussions

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Electrical, Mechanical, Computer Engineering, or related field (Master’s or PhD strongly preferred)
10+ years of experience in robotics engineering, including leadership of complex systems
Proven track record delivering robotic systems into real‑world deployment
Demonstrated experience leading senior technical teams and large programs

Robotics Expertise (Required)

Deep, hands‑on knowledge in several of the following:
Robotic system design and integration
Robot kinematics, dynamics, and control systems
Autonomous systems and motion planning
Sensing, perception, and sensor fusion (Lidar, vision, depth, IMUs)
Embedded systems, real‑time software, and robotics middleware (e.g., ROS/ROS2)
Hardware‑software co‑design and system debugging

Preferred Experience

Industrial, mobile, medical, autonomous, warehouse, or field robotics
Safety‑critical or regulated robotic systems
Manufacturing, reliability, and production scale‑up
Working with multidisciplinary teams across hardware, software, and AI

jobs.title: Principal (Director), Engineering & Capital Projects
jobs.description:
Chobani is growing—and we’re investing big in what’s next.
We’re hiring a Principal Engineer, Capital Projects
to lead complex, high‑impact projects that shape the future of our manufacturing network.

Summary

A Principal (Director) Engineer, Capital Projects within the Global Engineering and Project Management team. This critical leadership position is responsible for leading and execution of strategic capital projects within Chobani’s Global Supply Chain manufacturing facilities. The ideal candidate has a strong Industrial space background with responsibilities in a large global engineering team ranging from mechanical and electrical designs to software layer to deliver full sub-system capabilities. The team of professionals reporting to the role need to work cross-functionally, with both internal teams and external vendors, in the development of engineering solutions, from concept to final commissioning, ensuring the solution is beneficial for all teams. This position requires an experienced leader who can direct this group and assist them in the key decisions, while ensuring the projects remain on budget and within timelines. This position reports to the Vice President of Engineering and Project Management.

Responsibilities

Resource Management:

Lead Capital Critical Planning initiatives. With input from Sr Director of Engineering and Project Management develop, document, and track short term and long-term potential capital projects to align with company goals and objectives. Capital plan and execution including bringing forward new ideas and technologies to move the company forward and/or provide a competitive advantage
Ensure proper coordination of work between team, subcontractors, and clients
Ensure work is produced in adherence to company, contract, and client requirements
Identify obsolete or critical risk equipment and systems and bring forward a plan to prevent unplanned failure
When applicable, work effectively with maintenance team members to develop a solution
Consider impact of improvements on all facility functions (i.e., maintenance, EH&S, production) when developing plans and implementing changes
Work with all internal Plant Teams to identify, recommend, and implement manufacturing process improvement initiatives
Develops and works with supervisors in all areas such as employee relations, problem solving, setting, and achieving goals, manufacturing processes, skill development, scheduling, disciplinary action, terminations, equipment problems, etc. Aids employees and supervisors in solving work related problems; evaluates the issue and meets with supervisors and human resources to decide the most effective remediation technique
Set a positive and confident leadership example to all the employees and management. Promote positive employee relations through relationship building and issue resolution
Provide work assignments and review performance to ensure the efficient, cost-effective utilization of staff, including responsibility for recruitment, development, and retention of the staff

Account and Project Management:

Act as Sr PM for select projects
Lead budgeting process as it relates to global engineering areas. Track and is accountable for budgetary spending
Responsible for project performance of local work including project planning / forecasting, resource management, quality control, and profitability
Ensures manufacturing project engineering designs follow codes, standards, and regulations for Local, State and Federal Regulating Authorities along with FM Global
Provide engineered solutions and root cause analysis for complex manufacturing and support equipment issues for production facilities within Area of Responsibility
Continuously analyze costs and develop cost reduction plans for capital improvements and maintenance projects; provide support to facility managers in the implementation of cost reduction initiatives as needed
Monitors and reports performance of the manufacturing project (capital improvement or maintenance) to ensure that all contractual, costs and schedule objectives are met
Responsible for the communication of the manufacturing project status to all team members; conducts regularly scheduled manufacturing project reviews, provides timely project summaries and reports to senior management
Setting up and improving engineering standards and guidelines that will increase efficiency and accuracy associated with the engineering execution of the project
Develop, review and approval of Master Engineering Projects including drawings, specifications, data sheets and lists necessary to complete the projects, meeting project schedule and budget commitments
Organizes engineering support to construction and commissioning with occasional site visits

Requirements

15+ years’ experience in Manufacturing and Process Technologies. Previous experience with Food and Beverage or Consumer Packaged Goods companies required
Ten (10) years developing engineering strategy to support manufacturing environments is required
7+ years managerial and leadership experience over multiple engineering functions is required
7+ years of project management experience including project timeliness, budgets, risk analysis is required
Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering (chemical, mechanical, industrial, or process preferred)
Project/Program Management training and/or certification (PMP) is preferred
To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, including MS Project, familiarity with common CAD software (SolidWorks desired)
Ability to use sound creative thinking to solve complex manufacturing problems
Ability to travel is required
Demonstrated ability to provide both tactical and strategic leadership
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to build relationships and interact with individuals at all levels of an organization
Strong people management skills with the ability to train and develop others
The desire to make a significant difference. Must be self-motivated with the ability to work independently
Proficient using a PC and other department specific databases and/or systems and all assigned machinery and related equipment
Ability to work in a high-pressure environment and exercise good judgment to resolve problems in the absence of formalized guidelines and procedures.
SAP experience is desired but not required

About Us

Chobani is a food maker with a mission of making high-quality and nutritious food accessible to more people, while elevating our communities and making the world a healthier place. In short: making good food for all. In support of this mission, Chobani is a purpose-driven, people-first, food-and-wellness-focused company, and has been since its founding in 2005 by Hamdi Ulukaya, an immigrant to the U.S. The Company manufactures yogurt, oat milk, and creamers – Chobani yogurt is America's No.1 yogurt brand, made with natural ingredients without artificial preservatives. Following the 2023 acquisition of La Colombe, a leading coffee roaster with a shared commitment to quality, craftmanship and impact, the Company began selling cold-pressed espresso and lattes on tap at 32 cafes, as well as Ready to Drink (RTD) coffee beverages at retail.
Chobani uses food as a force for good in the world – putting humanity first in everything it does. The company’s philanthropic efforts prioritize giving back to its communities and beyond: working to eradicate child hunger, supporting immigrants, refugees and underrepresented people, honoring veterans, and protecting the planet. Chobani manufactures its products in New York, Idaho, Michigan and Australia, and its products are available throughout North America and distributed in Australia and other select markets.
For more information, please visit www.chobani.com and www.lacolombe.com , or follow us on Facebook , Twitter , Instagram and LinkedIn .
Chobani is an equal opportunity employer. Chobani will not discriminate against any applicant for employment on any basis including, but not limited to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, military and/or veteran status, marital status, predisposing genetic characteristics and genetic information, or any other classification protected by federal, state, and local laws.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, 401K match, short- and long-term disability coverage, health savings accounts, flexible spending accounts, and tuition reimbursement. We are also proud to offer specialized benefits like health care navigation, mental health services, fertility assistance, and paid parental leave as well as 120 hours of PTO and 11 Holidays each year.
Compensation Range: $140,000.00 - $220,000.00, plus bonus.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Overview

The Linac Coherent Light Source (LCLS) Engineering Division at the SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory is seeking a mechanical engineer to lead the Beam Delivery Systems Engineering Department.

LCLS is an X-ray Free Electron (FEL) facility, operated by Stanford University at the SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory, on behalf of the Department of Energy / Office of Science. This facility provides world-leading scientific capabilities to a global user community, covering a broad research portfolio that includes the development of advanced materials and chemical catalysts for clean energy systems; drug discovery for modern pharmaceuticals; and fundamental studies of astrophysical phenomena. Seven (7) independent instruments are specifically designed to utilize the unique beam characteristics of the LCLS to meet these scientific objectives.

The Beam Delivery Systems Engineering Department supports LCLS with mechanical engineers and engineering physicists. The department supports the design, operations, and maintenance of the X-ray beam paths to ensure systems meet experimental requirements and reliably deliver X-ray photons on target. This includes developing mechatronic and optomechanical systems to precisely control X-ray beam alignment, wavefront, and timing. And the design, characterization, and procurement of high-performance X-ray mirrors. This department operates off-line laboratories for advanced metrology of X-ray mirrors and new techniques to clean mirror coatings in situ.

As the head of the Beam Delivery Systems Engineering Department, in addition to engineering responsibilities, you will manage a team of engineers, provide supervision, guidance and training, foster staff development, promote engineering rigor, and participate in hiring activities to support the LCLS mission. This position administratively reports to the LCLS Engineering Division Leader within the LCLS Directorate.

Your Specific Responsibilities Include

Provide engineering leadership for new initiatives that advances advance X-ray experimental capabilities through delivery of complex scientific instrumentation, X-ray and laser system opto-mechanical systems, experiment and beamline diagnostics, and target delivery systems.
Provide engineering leadership for the integration and testing of systems and devices, working with staff scientists, fabrication facilities and personnel, and technicians.
Responsible for the execution and delivery of technical scope, within budget and on schedule, with a high degree of quality assurance using standardized engineering processes.
May function as a Cost Account Manager (CAM) in project management roles.
Promote adherence to the LCLS Conduct of Engineering, ensuring engineering rigor with accurate documentation and engineering review.
Provide the department with leadership in project engineering to support system development, integration, commissioning and the effective transfer of new capabilities to operations.
Prepare and conduct performance management activities for department personnel and contribute to the LCLS engineering ranking and salary management processes.
Influence strategic technical decisions made by LCLS senior management.
Contribute to the definition of complex engineering solutions for X-ray based experiments.
Perform engineering duties requiring significant scheduling and budgeting responsibility.

To Be Successful In This Position You Will Bring

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field and at least eight years of experience with the design and operation of beam delivery systems.
Leadership, interpersonal skills, organizational, and supervisory skills to lead personnel, write performance appraisals, and actively participate in ranking and hiring activities.
Experience with engineering tools such as Solid Edge, ANSYS and/or MATLAB.
Ability to promote and maintain productive relationships across LCLS and SLAC.
Expert communication, facilitation, and collaboration skills, necessary to present, explain, and advise LCLS senior management and/or external sponsors.
Experience working independently and responsively to changing priorities and ability to meet deadlines
Manufacturing, assembly, and installation coordination of complex systems.
Exercising sound engineering judgment.
Demonstrated ability to work independently and in a diverse team environment.

In Addition, Preferred Requirements Include

An advanced degree and experience with scientific instrumentation, project management, and/or technical supervision.
Experience in X-ray FEL, synchrotron, metrology, and/or laser system engineering.
Experience with user facilities and/or national laboratories.
Formal training/experience in systems engineering processes and methodologies

Summary

RESPONSIBILITIES

Leader who has consistently demonstrated establishing or leading research programs, projects, groups, or mission critical systems that are essential to meeting the scientific and operational goals of the laboratory.

Scope Of Impact

Provides leadership identifying, promoting, and developing core laboratory capabilities, influencing future scientific or technicaldirection of the laboratory.

Delivers research or technology objectives with high distinction.

Knowledge And Expertise

Generates and develops advanced scientific or technical capabilities in a broad field of knowledge for several applications and has fully demonstrated grasp of related disciplines.

Consistently leads focused research, technologies, design, or facility operations with creativity and innovation.

Demonstrated excellence in communicating research progress to both internal and external audiences.

Directing Others/Supervision

Demonstrated ability to build and lead effective teams and to actively mentor staff.

Program Development

Generates new applications, programs or proposals and leads their development.

Generates solutions to key technical or scientific challenges critical to program/project success.

Minimum Education And Experience Required

BS in applicable engineering or scientific discipline and 8 years of relevant experience

About Us

SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory explores how the universe works at the biggest, smallest and fastest scales and invents powerful tools used by researchers around the globe. As world leaders in ultrafast science and bold explorers of the physics of the universe, we forge new ground in understanding our origins and building a healthier and more sustainable future. Our discovery and innovation help develop new materials and chemical processes and open unprecedented views of the cosmos and life’s most delicate machinery. Building on more than 60 years of visionary research, we help shape the future by advancing areas such as quantum technology, scientific computing and the development of next-generation accelerators.

SLAC is operated by Stanford University for the U.S. Department of Energy’s Office of Science . The Office of Science is the single largest supporter of basic research in the physical sciences in the United States and is working to address some of the most pressing challenges of our time.

Lead engineering delivery across Platform, Applications, Embedded Software, Data Science, and Hardware Engineering, with every director and manager in these functions reporting through this role.

Next-generation sensor design decisions are locked and moving through execution toward launch

Nexus Core is on a predictable release cadence that consistently meets external commitments across SaaS and on-premise deployments.
The org is staffed with strong managers and senior ICs across Platform, Applications, Data Science, and Hardware/Firmware.

How To Succeed In This Role

Critical Thinking: Diagnose complex delivery, architecture, and hardware trade-offs across software and hardware. Push the organization toward evidence-based decisions over assumptions.
Taking Ownership: Own delivery outcomes for Nexus Core and the sensor fleet end to end. Hold every commitment to a named owner and a clear status.
Judgment & Decision Making: Weigh risk and opportunity across competing priorities in software and hardware delivery. Make the call, communicate it clearly, and stand behind it.
Stakeholder Management: Align Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance on delivery commitments and forecasts. Represent engineering credibly to the executive team.

Essential Skills

12+ years in engineering, with several years leading engineering organizations that shipped production software to external customers, preferably in industrial markets.
Track record delivering a multi-tenant SaaS platform from architecture through general availability, then running its ongoing release cadence against hard external commitments.
Experience running on-premise or privately deployed software for enterprise customers with strict security or compliance requirements.
Hands-on hardware design experience for industrial or field-deployed products, including environmental hardening and certifications (UL, CE, FCC, IP-rated enclosures).

Startup experience ramping a company from 1-N.
NERC CIP or comparable regulated critical-infrastructure experience.
Personally built data products or analytics platforms, not just partnered with the team building them.
Grid intelligence or dynamic line rating domain experience, or direct hardware/firmware, embedded, or OTA background.

Reporting & Team Structure

Reports to the CTO.
Lead an organization of 35+ full-time leaders, engineers and contractors, spanning Platform, Applications, and Embedded Software, Data Science, and Hardware Engineering.
Collaborates closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance.

What does joining LineVision mean for you?

Impact. Your talent, time, and energy will critically impact our success in delivering utilities with grid intelligence to enable affordable, reliable power.
Ownership. You will hold broad responsibilities with high autonomy and trust in a communicative, collaborative, and fast-paced environment.
Flexibility. You will be empowered to maintain work-life balance with trust-based PTO.
Real World Innovation. You will lead a motivated, high-performing team working with cutting edge, patented technology to help utilities meet the demands of an AI-powered future.

Who We Are…

LineVision is a grid-enhancing technology company enabling electric utilities to deliver affordable, reliable power and accelerate the electrification of the global economy. Our grid intelligence platform delivers the most accurate, network-wide dynamic line ratings and enables safer, more reliable grid operations with a combination of optical sensors and advanced environmental modeling. LineVision's global customer base includes eight of the ten largest US utilities, including National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.

So whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this role would make you excited to come to work every day.

Insitu is redefining the future of unmanned aviation, delivering autonomous vehicle systems and mission solutions that support critical intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) missions for global defense and security customers. As our Vice President, Engineering and Technology, you will be the senior technical leader guiding the next generation of Insitu’s platforms, payloads, autonomy, and mission services—shaping how our customers sense, decide, and act in the most demanding environments.

This is a high‑impact, enterprise‑wide role that combines technology strategy, engineering leadership, and operational integration. You will report directly to the CEO, lead both Engineering and Flight Operations through your department directors, and set the technical direction that underpins Insitu’s growth, competitiveness, and long‑term innovation roadmap.

Job Description Summary

The Vice President of Engineering and Technology is the company’s senior technical leader and primary technology strategist. This role owns the long‑term technology vision and roadmap for our autonomous systems portfolio and ensures that major business and investment decisions are grounded in deep technical insight and aligned with company strategy and customer mission needs.

The VP, Engineering and Technology sets and communicates the technology direction, architects the product and platform strategy, prioritizes R&D and capital investments, and maintains a coherent “system‑of‑systems” vision across platforms, payloads, autonomy, ground systems, and data/software.

This role reports to the Chief Executive Officer and is a key member of the executive leadership team, acting as the company’s chief technical authority and external technology ambassador.

The Engineering and Flight Operations departments both report directly to this position. The VP, Engineering and Technology provides executive leadership and guidance to both organizations and is accountable for integrating Engineering and Flight Operations to deliver safe, reliable, and innovative autonomous vehicle systems and mission services that meet customer, quality, regulatory, and contractual requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Vision, Strategy & Architecture
Own and continuously evolve the company’s multi‑year technology vision and roadmap for unmanned and autonomous systems, aligned with long‑range business plans, customer mission outcomes, and innovation priorities.
Lead portfolio‑level technology and architecture decisions (e.g., make/buy/partner, modularity vs. integration, open architectures) to optimize capability, schedule, lifecycle cost, and technical risk.
Translate emerging tech trends (autonomy/AI, advanced sensors, secure networking, cloud‑enabled mission services, digital engineering) into concrete, prioritized roadmaps and investment themes.
Chair key technical governance forums (e.g., Architecture Review Board, Design Authority reviews) to maintain technical integrity, reuse, and common standards across programs.
Innovation, R&D & Productization
Drive a focused, high‑impact R&D portfolio aligned with the technology strategy and customer needs, making clear go/hold/stop decisions on major technology bets.
Guide the maturation of technologies from concept and prototype through flight test, production, and in‑service evolution.
Sponsor and review research and case studies on leading‑edge technologies, identifying differentiating capabilities and ensuring rapid learning cycles (demo, test, iterate).
Chief Technical Authority & Governance
Serve as the company’s ultimate technical authority for key design and architecture decisions, technical risk acceptance, and technology trade‑offs.
Establish and track key technical KPIs/OKRs (e.g., defect rates, design cycle times, test coverage, reliability metrics) and drive continuous improvement based on data.
Engineering & Flight Organization Leadership
Lead and integrate a multi‑disciplinary Engineering organization (Systems, Software, AI/Autonomy, Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Payloads, Test) to deliver cohesive, high‑impact solutions for global defense and security customers.
Scale and structure the Engineering and Flight Operations organizations to meet strategic growth; assign authority and responsibility to department directors and their leadership teams, and monitor execution.
Build and maintain a strong technical ladder, including Principal/Chief Engineers, to provide deep expertise, mentorship, and design leadership across programs.
Provide strategic oversight and technical direction through the Director, Flight Operations to ensure operations (flight test, training, deployed missions) are tightly integrated with the technology roadmap and product strategy
Customer, Market & Ecosystem Engagement
Engage directly with key customers, end‑users, and partners to understand mission problems, shape the technology roadmap around real operational needs, and advocate for investment priorities.
Represent the company’s technology strategy and capabilities at customer briefings, industry events, standards bodies, and with key suppliers, serving as an external technical thought leader.
Provide authoritative technical input to major pursuits and strategic partnerships, including solution architectures, discriminators, and risk/feasibility assessments.
Executive Leadership, Culture & Governance
Partner with Programs, Operations, Product Lines, Business Development, and Finance to ensure technology strategy and engineering execution support growth, profitability, and long‑range business plans.
Lead, mentor, and inspire Engineering and Flight Operations leadership and their teams, reinforcing a culture of technical excellence, safety, integrity, and accountability.
Build and sustain an inclusive, high‑performance culture that attracts, develops, and retains top technical and operational talent.
Own Engineering and Flight Operations budgets and resource plans, ensuring investments and staffing align with strategic priorities and program commitments.

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a closely related technical discipline from an accredited institution.

Experience

Extensive experience in aerospace, defense, and/or autonomous systems, with significant time in senior technical leadership roles (e.g., Vice President, Chief Engineer, Head of Engineering, or equivalent).
Demonstrated experience defining and executing technology strategy and technical roadmaps for complex, software‑enabled hardware products.
Proven track record partnering with Programs/Operations and Business Development to deliver on schedule, on budget, and to spec for government or highly regulated customers.
Demonstrated success managing sizable departmental budgets and contributing to annual operating plans and long‑range business planning.
Ability to engage credibly at a deep technical level (e.g., architecture trade‑offs, algorithm performance, system safety, test strategies) while maintaining a portfolio‑level strategic view.

Leadership & Interpersonal Skills

Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high‑performing technical organizations in fast‑paced, mission‑driven environments.
Strong cross‑functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders from engineering, operations, programs, finance, and business development.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics in clear business and operational terms to executives, customers, and partners.
Proven ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, make sound decisions with incomplete data, and drive clarity, focus, and accountability.

Desired Qualifications

Ability to obtain or maintain a Secret Security Clearance
Prior experience as a senior technology leader (e.g., VP‑level Engineering/Technology, Chief Engineer) in aerospace, defense, or autonomous systems organizations.
Deep familiarity with small tactical UAS, ISR mission concepts, and associated ground and data systems.
Hands‑on or leadership experience in autonomy/AI for UAS, advanced payloads, mission systems, or secure communications networks.
Demonstrated experience with Profit & Loss responsibility or strong P&L fluency in a technology‑ and operations‑intensive business.
Familiarity with export control environments (e.g., ITAR/EAR) and experience working with U.S. and/or allied defense and security customers.

This role is eligible for hybrid work. There is a strong preference that this individual is on site at our facilities in Bingen, WA 3+ days/week. The ability to travel is required - travel needs will vary based on customer/partnership opportunities, timing of events, etc.

At Insitu, we strive to deliver a Total Rewards package that will attract, engage and retain the top talent. Elements of the Total Rewards package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities.

Insitu also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability programs and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.

The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire.

jobs.title: Senior Plant Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
POSITION DESCRIPTION:
The Senior Plant Engineering Manager is responsible for leading all engineering, continuous improvement, and capital project execution activities at the DrinkPAK plant they support. This role serves as the senior on-site engineering lead—embedded at the plant but reporting directly to Corporate Engineering Services—with direct ownership of a very large, multi-million dollar annual capital portfolio spanning multiple projects, production lines, and infrastructure systems simultaneously. The leader drives reliability, throughput, and technical readiness while ensuring the plant maintains clean, accurate, and reusable engineering assets across all active and completed initiatives. This role is a Plant Embedded Senior Engineering & Multi-Project Execution Leader.

BENEFITS:
The health and well-being of our teams are important to us. We offer:
FREE PPO medical, dental, and vision insurance for our employees AND their dependents
A cell phone stipend
Annual discretionary bonus
401(k) match program, pet insurance, life insurance, and more.

LOCATION:
The position is based at DrinkPAK’s Beverage Manufacturing Facility in Fort Worth, Texas.
TYPE:
Full Time; Salaried / Exempt

RESPONSIBILITIES

Own and manage a very large, multi-million dollar annual capital project portfolio, overseeing multiple concurrent projects and production line initiatives from scoping through commissioning and turnover.
Lead on-site engineering support across all active production lines, ensuring technical readiness, reliability, and rapid resolution of complex cross-line issues.
Drive continuous improvement programs focused on uptime, throughput, energy efficiency, and cost reduction across the full plant footprint.
Maintain and govern engineering documentation, as builts, equipment lists, and technical standards in coordination with Corporate Engineering Services; ensure accuracy and reusability across all project phases.
Partner with Corporate Engineering on capital prioritization, multi-project sequencing, annual budgeting, and cross-site standardization initiatives.
Develop, submit, and manage requests for bid; evaluate contractor and vendor proposals across concurrent scopes of work.
Provide engineering input into annual expense and capital budgeting processes; track spend, forecast variances, and escalate risks proactively across the portfolio.
Support maintenance teams with root cause analysis, reliability improvements, and long-term corrective actions across multiple systems and lines.
Coordinate with OEMs, contractors, and vendors for equipment upgrades, retrofits, repairs, and technical evaluations across active project scopes.
Lead technical readiness for new equipment installations, line modifications, and process changes affecting multiple production lines simultaneously.
Ensure all plant engineering activities comply with safety, regulatory, and environmental requirements.
Support plant outage planning, utility coordination, and infrastructure reliability improvements across the full site.
Build strong relationships with plant leadership while maintaining corporate reporting alignment and serving as the senior engineering authority on site.

Key KPIs & Best-in-Class Targets

Capital Project On Time Delivery.
Capital Portfolio Budget Variance.
Multi-Project Schedule Adherence.
Commissioning Readiness On Time. DrinkPAK places exceptional value on machine uptime — early or on time readiness is the expectation, not the exception
Engineering Documentation Accuracy.
Corrective Action Closure Lead Time.
Safety Performance: Zero engineering-related incidents
Energy Efficiency Improvement.
Root Cause Analysis Completion.

Please note this job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without prior notice.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering preferred; equivalent experience considered.
At least 8 years of engineering experience in manufacturing, CPG, food/beverage, high-speed manufacturing, or industrial environments, with demonstrated progression in scope and capital responsibility.
Proven experience managing concurrent, multi-project capital portfolios of significant scale in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
Strong understanding of utilities, mechanical systems, electrical systems, and plant infrastructure across multi-line production environments.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, P&IDs, and OEM documentation across multiple simultaneous scopes.
Proficiency with project management tools
Strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to interface at all levels of the organization.
Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, complex sequencing, and high capital accountability in a fast-paced production environment.
Detail-oriented with strong documentation, organizational, and risk management capabilities.

OUR VALUES

Our company’s culture is guided by our shared values of Speed, Intensity, and Purpose. These values are demonstrated in the following ways based on the role within the organization.
Speed
: Take the initiative to promptly identify and address potential issues or opportunities. Maintain a sense of urgency in your work, completing tasks efficiently.
Intensity
: Remain resilient in the face of challenges and setbacks by possessing a positive attitude, persevering through obstacles, and demonstrating adaptability in your approach.
Purpose
: Take ownership of your responsibilities, and value the input and skillsets of your peers by working together as One PAK.

ABOUT DRINKPAK

DrinkPAK is the premiere manufacturer of canned beverages in North America. As producers of the largest and fastest-growing alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages in the world, DrinkPAK provides full-service support for procurement, batching, processing, filling, packaging, warehousing, and distribution. Founded in 2020, DrinkPAK has revolutionized canned beverage manufacturing by offering extreme capacity and format flexibility through cutting-edge technology and a commitment to the best talent in the industry. For more information, visit www.drinkpak.com.

WORKING CONDITIONS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
Should be able to work in environments with variable noise levels, lighting conditions, and temperature variation, and be able to access all areas of the building without limitations.
The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms above the head and below the waist.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit, climb, or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl for 10-12 hours.
Be able to lift and carry up to 50lbs

jobs.description:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, related field, or equivalent practical experience.
15 years of experience with storage systems.
15 years of experience managing teams, including teams with multiple levels.
Experience working with hardware device suppliers and system vendors.

Preferred qualifications:

PhD degree in a field related to computer systems.
Experience with storage platforms software at hyperscale.
Experience with cloud virtualization, storage AI/ML needs, and bare metal as a service.
Experience planning and delivering complex system software.
Experience delivering storage systems at scale with commercial success.

About The Job

Platforms Engineering performs research, design, and development for the hardware, software, and networking technologies that power all of Google's products and services. The product lines include servers, ASICs, and accelerator systems and storage (e.g., HDDs, SSDs, persistent storage tech, etc.). The customers include Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Ads, Search, YouTube, Gmail, Maps, and more. Platforms offers impactful projects at every level of the technology stack, from the chip level to massive distributed systems design and software development.

In this role, you will manage and build a team of software developers and management leaders at the boundary of hardware/software interaction and upstack innovation with other systems and services like cloud virtualizations, AI/ML applications, and file and object storage.

Additionally, you will be responsible for building storage solutions for all of Google’s services (e.g., Search, Ads, Gmail/Drive, Maps, YouTube, Photos, databases, etc.), AI/ML, and Cloud. The team designs and develops platform software and system designs based on flash, hard disk drives (HDDs), and next-generation disruptive storage technologies.

You will lead innovations and development of various system architectures that will enable us to meet the efficiency challenges of the exponential byte growth and the workloads across all Google AI/ML services, cloud, and virtualized environments.

The ML, Systems, & Cloud AI (MSCA) organization at Google designs, implements, and manages the hardware, software, machine learning, and systems infrastructure for all Google services (Search, YouTube, etc.) and Google Cloud. Our end users are Googlers, Cloud customers and the billions of people who use Google services around the world.

We prioritize security, efficiency, and reliability across everything we do - from developing our latest TPUs to running a global network, while driving towards shaping the future of hyperscale computing. Our global impact spans software and hardware, including Google Cloud’s Vertex AI, the leading AI platform for bringing Gemini models to enterprise customers.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $307000 - $427000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Collaborate with vendors, internal product areas (e.g., Cloud, Search, AI/ML, file/object storage teams, etc.) to enable timely onboarding of new storage systems and a flexible portfolio strategy.
Manage, lead, and grow a team of system software developers and managers.
Drive a proactive industry influence agenda towards lowering the barrier of entry to Google Cloud for a wider portfolio of hardware, such as Enterprise.

jobs.title: Vice President of Technology
jobs.description:
Location:
Auburn, WA (onsite/hybrid)
Reports to:
Jon Bach, Founder & President
Team:
2 IT technicians, 1 software developer, 1 TPM, plans to add 1-2 senior developers

About Puget Systems

Puget Systems builds high-performance custom workstations and servers for professionals in content creation, engineering, scientific computing, and AI/ML. For over two decades we've differentiated ourselves through obsessive quality, published reliability data, in-house benchmarking research (Puget Labs), and a consultative approach to every sale. We're a ~75-person company that competes with billion-dollar OEMs by being smarter, faster, and more genuinely customer-focused than they can be.

A significant part of that advantage is invisible to customers: a custom-built internal business operating system that runs configuration, quoting, purchasing, inventory, and production across the company. It was built by our founder over many years, and it is deeply fitted to how we work. It is a strategic advantage, but requires a full technology team to maintain and build on top of it.

About the Role

Until a few years ago, software and IT at Puget Systems were run personally by our founder. The technology department that exists today is young: a small, capable team of four people, informal processes, and a homegrown platform that is accompanied by a lot of tribal knowledge. We are looking for a VP of Technology to take true ownership of the systems, the team, and the roadmap and mature it into a sustainable system without losing the pragmatism and specialization that made it valuable in the first place.

This will always be a small team. If you're looking to build a large organization, this is not the role for you. But if you want to be the most senior technical person at a successful, profitable, and respected company, leading a small but effective team with outsized strategic impact, and a seat on the Executive Leadership Team… read on!

What You'll Own

The internal business platform.
Take over stewardship of our custom-built business OS from the founder. Learn the extensive legacy code base deeply, and lead the strategy for what to maintain, refactor, replace, or retire with deliberate architecture decisions rather than a reflex to rewrite. The platform is built on the LAMP stack.
The software team and products.
Mentor our software developers into confident, capable engineers, and hire 1-2 senior developers to raise the technical ceiling. Establish and maintain standards for the software team: source control discipline, code review, release management, testing, and build a culture of ownership and delivery of results.
The IT team and infrastructure.
Manage the internal IT team and oversee IT operations for the whole company. Oversee network configuration for reliability and security, and maintain our internal servers and infrastructure across onsite, colocation, and cloud environments. Craft our plan for 24/7 incident response, and follow it.
The public website.
Own www.pugetsystems.com, our WordPress-based front-end site that is our storefront and the home of our published research. This includes the API integrations that tie it back to our internal systems.
The internal website.
Codenamed “NAV” , this is the internal business OS that has an extensive code base and history. It will be a significant effort to learn this system and maintain it. Everyone who has come before you has under-estimated this system.
Data integrations and reporting.
Manage our connections to external platforms and services. We have decided that “NAV” is the central data hub. You will own this data, and its connectors to BI reporting, ensuring the business has reliable, trustworthy data to run on.
Cybersecurity.
Maintain and enforce cybersecurity standards company-wide, including the specific requirements embedded in our customer contracts. Own backup and disaster recovery.
Documentation and process maturity.
Establish the practices a mature technology organization needs, including documentation, well-defined processes, and task management workflows in ClickUp. We want this to be sized appropriately for a 75-person company, not over-complicated. Build internal support and prioritization processes so the rest of the company knows how to work with the team.
Budget and financial management.
Execute the annual budgeting process for the department, report expenses via Ramp, and manage the team to its monthly budget.
A seat on the Executive Leadership Team.
This role sits on the ELT, the group responsible for shaping the strategy and direction of the company. You'll represent technology at that table and you'll be expected to contribute to long term company-level decisions well beyond your own department.
Technology strategy.
Partner with the founder and leadership team to decide where technology investment creates competitive advantage, and where it doesn't. Translate business needs into a realistic roadmap, and deliver on it.

Where This Role Grows: Puget Labs

Puget Labs is the heart and soul of Puget Systems, and the moat around our business. It consists of two teams working as two sides of the same coin:

The Performance Lab
studies real end-user workflows and benchmarks computer hardware against them. They publish widely-read articles and are recognized figureheads in the industry. Puget Systems has built its reputation on this work.
The R&D Lab
engages directly with the PC hardware ecosystem (component manufacturers and vendors) to qualify components and design the laptops, workstations, servers, and storage that meet the workflow needs the Performance Lab identifies.

This VP will not own Puget Labs on day one. The job starts with software and IT. But once that foundation is well in hand, leadership of Puget Labs is the intended growth path for this role, bringing the company's core differentiator under the same technology leadership. Candidates should be genuinely excited by that trajectory: this is ultimately a role that grows into stewarding what makes Puget Systems special.

Who You Are

A player-coach, permanently.
You are a strong hands-on engineer who still writes and reviews code, and you expect to keep doing so.
Experienced with inherited systems.
You've taken ownership of large, long-lived, lightly-documented codebases before (ideally from the original author) and you know how to handle that transition.
A builder of teams.
You have a track record of growing junior developers into strong ones, and of hiring well. You mentor others, even those not on your team.
Pragmatic about processes.
You know that process and documentation sets up a team for success, and you calibrate to company size.
Broad across software and IT.
You're credible leading both application development and IT/infrastructure/security for a mid-sized business.
A clear communicator with non-technical leaders.
You can explain tradeoffs, set expectations, and earn trust across sales, production, and operations teams whose daily work runs on your systems.
Financially accountable.
You've owned a department budget before and treat it as a real commitment, including planning annually, tracking monthly, and making tradeoffs transparently.

Qualifications

10+ years in software development and/or IT, including 3+ years leading a technology function as Director, VP, CTO, or Head of Engineering/IT.
Direct experience owning both software and IT for a mid-sized business (roughly 50–500 employees). We're looking for proof you've done this specific job, not a scaled-down version of a big-company role, and not a first step up from team lead.
A track record of maturing a technology organization: you can point to specific practices you established, systems you stabilized or replaced, and people who grew under your leadership.
Deep hands-on proficiency with the LAMP stack, which our internal platform is built on, plus working fluency with a modern JavaScript framework (we've tentatively standardized on Vue for new projects); WordPress and API-driven integration experience is a plus.
Prior ownership of a department budget.

Physical Requirements

Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
Able to work from home or office.
Able to travel for trade shows and other activities.

Nice to Have

Experience in manufacturing, e-commerce, or configure-to-order businesses
Experience working directly with a founder/owner in a succession or transition capacity
Familiarity with ERP internal systems, whether homegrown or commercial
Experience building or managing data lakes, data pipelines, and BI reporting stacks
Experience meeting security requirements (e.g., customer security requirements, SOC2, NIST, or CMMC frameworks)

Why This Role Is Worth It

You'll inherit a genuinely interesting technical asset, a supportive founder who wants to hand it off well, a profitable and stable company with a strong reputation, and a team eager to grow. Your decisions will affect the entire company, and the role grows into stewardship of Puget Labs, who is the industry-respected source of our reputation. Few VP roles offer this much ownership with this little bureaucracy.

Benefits Include:

M/D/V
PTO and STO - Standard policy is 2 weeks PTO to start, +1 day / year until 4 week maximum
Paid holidays - 8 days + 2 floating holiday per year
Paid parental leave - 3 weeks
Paid Medical Hardship Leave - up to 2 weeks / year
Paid jury duty leave - up to 2 weeks / year
4% match on 401(k), immediate vesting
Volunteer Matching Program
Wellness Reimbursement Program
Company-sponsored financial counseling

We give additional consideration to those who include a cover letter.

A background check will be run prior to hire. We are an EEO employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other protected class. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa.
